intro: This library is reviewed against primary sources, not secondary summaries. 10 changes in the last ninety days, from the state bill tracker and the framework explainers, newest first.

items.body: The federal AI bills in play, what they would do if passed, and the operating posture you should hold while they develop.
items.headline: Federal AI Legislation

items.body: The Genesis Mission is the federal government's AI for science programme, launched by executive order on 24 November 2025 and run by the Department of Energy across its 17 national laboratories. In July 2026 the White House put more than $5 billion of federal commitments behind it and selected 278 projects. Compute comes from companies: Microsoft's $60 million in July, and National Compute's $100 million in credits reported in October.
items.headline: The Genesis Mission

items.body: Utah requires generative AI to disclose it is not a person, enforced by the Division of Consumer Protection with fines to $2,500 per violation. Amended in 2025 to narrow the general duty to high-risk interactions, with a stricter always-on rule for regulated occupations.
items.headline: Utah AI Policy Act

items.body: From January 1, 2029, nobody may offer, sell or conduct a covered AI audit in California without registering with the Government Operations Agency. AB 1405 builds that registry; SB 813 creates a separate, higher designation for independent verification organizations. Licensed CPAs are deemed to satisfy the conduct and reporting rules by following AICPA attestation standards.
items.headline: California AI Auditor Registration: SB 813 and AB 1405

items.body: ISO/IEC 42001 certificates, 42006 and 17021-1 auditors, 42005 impact assessments, 17025 testing laboratories and benchmark scores each prove something different; this page says what each output does and does not show.

items.body: China issued the first dedicated governance framework for AI agents on May 8, 2026, defining an agent in law and setting a three-tier decision-authorization model. A separate companion-AI rule took effect July 15, 2026 and forced Doubao and Qwen to pull their companion features. The two are constantly conflated. They are different instruments doing different jobs.
items.headline: China AI Regulation
